name: Remifi
description: In DeFi, paying a team means calculate shares, send a transfer, send another, track tx hashes, repeat — step after step. What if your agent just did all of it? One hire. Every recipient paid. Proof on Celo. Remifi is the composable USDC payout leg for payroll, treasury, and creator revenue — with ERC-8021 attribution and optional x402 hire settlement.

skills.name: Create payout name
skills.description: Register a human-readable payout identity for a recipient (ENS / Base-style naming where supported).

skills.name: Create split policy
skills.description: Define multi-recipient USDC split rules (JSON or natural language). Recipients by wallet or ENS / Base name. Returns a reusable policyId.

skills.name: Execute payroll
skills.description: One hire → Router executeSplit pays every policy recipient on Celo mainnet with ERC-8021 attribution. Returns job proof + Celoscan links.

skills.name: Resolve name
skills.description: Verify a wallet, ENS, or Base name before you pay.

skills.name: Instant USDC pay
skills.description: Single-shot tagged USDC to any wallet or ENS / Base name. Optional x402 hire settlement for Track 2.

skills.name: Split quote (x402)
skills.description: Paid split preview for agent planners. GET /api/quote?policyId=&amount= with X-PAYMENT. Counts toward Track 2; pair with POST /api/execute for tagged USDC.

skills.name: Recurring payroll
skills.description: Set-and-forget tagged USDC payroll on a 20-minute+ cadence. POST /api/schedules; cron POST /api/schedules/heartbeat.

skills.name: Job / delivery proof
skills.description: Fetch job status, transfer hashes, and explorer links for a completed payout.

skills.name: Agent health
skills.description: Liveness, chain connectivity, agent USDC balance hint, router + x402 facilitator status.
